summary: MCBS LLC, a medical billing and business services provider, discovered unauthorized access to its computer network that occurred between September 22–26, 2025, affecting approximately 385 individuals in Massachusetts who are patients of healthcare practices using MCBS's billing services. The company discovered the breach on May 28, 2026, after an extensive forensic investigation and reported it to the California Attorney General on June 26, 2026. Exposed data included names, dates of birth, addresses, Social Security numbers, diagnoses, medical history, treatment information, health insurance policy numbers, and other PII and PHI. MCBS offered affected individuals complimentary identity protection services and established a dedicated response line to assist with questions and protective measures.
